prompt: Write a police officer's crash report narrative (about 120 words). Collision type: rear-end collision in Pearland, Texas. The claimant was a driver and reported whiplash. Refer to people as Driver 1, Driver 2 or Passenger. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1147; do not mention it.)
text: Officer narrative. On arrival at the scene in Pearland, Texas, I observed two vehicles in the northbound lanes with rear-end damage consistent with a collision. Driver 2 stated that traffic ahead had slowed and that they applied the brakes but could not stop in time before striking the rear of the vehicle operated by Driver 1. Driver 1 stated that their vehicle was stopped at the time of impact. A passenger was present in Driver 1's vehicle and was checked at the scene. Driver 1 reported neck pain and stiffness consistent with whiplash and was advised to seek medical evaluation. Both vehicles were drivable and were moved to the shoulder. No citations were issued at the scene pending further investigation. Weather was clear and the roadway was dry. Photographs were taken and statements were recorded from all parties.
